meta.name: caveman
meta.description: Ultra-compressed communication mode. Cuts output tokens 65% (measured) by speaking like caveman while keeping full technical accuracy. Supports intensity levels: lite, full (default), ultra, wenyan-lite, wenyan-full, wenyan-ultra. Use when user says "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "use caveman", "less tokens", "be brief", or invokes /caveman. Also auto-triggers when token efficiency is requested.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用原始人语气压缩 AI 回复,最高省 65% 输出量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望 AI 回复更简短、更省 token
copy.tagline_en: Speak caveman to slash token output by up to 65%.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want terse AI responses and lower token usage.

howto.what: 回答改用极简「原始人」式短句:删掉冠词、废话、客套话,保留全部技术细节;代码、报错原文、术语原样保留,且不发明新缩写。模式持续生效直到你说「stop caveman」或「normal mode」。共六档强度(lite/full/ultra/文言文等),默认 full。
howto.when: 当你说「caveman mode」「less tokens」等触发词、输入 /caveman 命令,或要求回答更省 token 时,自动触发该模式。

say.note: 进入精简「原始人」回答模式。
切到 ultra 档,句子更短更碎。
恢复正常语气,退出模式。

howto.what_en: Terse caveman replies: drop articles, filler, pleasantries; keep technical facts, code, exact errors; no invented abbreviations. Active every turn until "stop caveman"/"normal mode". Six levels, default full.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says "caveman mode", "less tokens" etc., invokes /caveman, or asks for token-efficient output.

say_en.note: Switches to the most compressed level.
Turns the mode off, back to normal.
